sources.title: THC Cannabis Plant Science Source Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Project plant-development, postharvest, evidence, and transfer boundaries.

sources.title: THC Cultivation SOP Source Materials Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Project source for harvest, drying, water activity, sampling, QA, sanitation, deviations, and release.

sources.title: Livingston et al. (2023). Glandular trichome development and maturation in high-THC cannabis. Journal of Cannabis Research.
sources.useAndLimitation: Trichome-stage heterogeneity and color limits.

sources.title: Livingston et al. (2023). Glandular trichome development and maturation in high-THC cannabis. Journal of Cannabis Research.
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific trichome-development evidence; maturation signals vary by tissue position, genotype, developmental stage, and measurement method, so trichome appearance should not be treated as a single universal harvest clock.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Drying, trimming, psychrometrics, moisture, curing, storage, and evidence gaps.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis postharvest review covering drying, trimming, curing, packaging, storage, moisture, and water activity; process outcomes remain cultivar-, load-, equipment-, and environment-specific.

sources.title: U.S. FDA — Current Good Manufacturing Practices (CGMPs) for Food and Dietary Supplements
sources.useAndLimitation: Authoritative sanitation and hygienic-design principles for personnel, equipment, sanitary operations, and process controls; used as a transferable hygiene framework, not as a claim that food CGMP law universally governs cannabis flower.

sources.title: Current cannabis inventory, waste, and batch-control rules
sources.useAndLimitation: Jurisdiction-specific release review.

sources.title: Optimization of Trimming Techniques for Medical Cannabis (2024)
sources.useAndLimitation: One-chemovar trimming study; no universal method superiority.

sources.title: Post-Harvest Operations to Generate High-Quality Medicinal Cannabis Products: A Systemic Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Drying, equilibrium moisture, aW, storage, and quality context.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific synthesis of drying, equilibrium moisture, water activity, sorption, packaging, and storage principles; heat/mass-transfer coefficients remain system-specific.

sources.title: ASTM D8196-22 — Standard Practice for Determination of Water Activity (aw) in Cannabis Flower
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific water-activity measurement practice; standards version, instrument instructions, sample conditioning, and jurisdictional applicability require release-time verification.

sources.title: U.S. FDA — Water Activity (aw) in Foods
sources.useAndLimitation: Authoritative definition of water activity, ERH relationship, temperature sensitivity, and sorption-isotherm concepts; food microbial thresholds are not automatically cannabis release specifications.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-focused discussion of water activity, equilibrium moisture content, sorption isotherms, drying, and packaging; cultivar-specific sorption behavior and hysteresis remain evidence gaps.

sources.title: Volume 05 sensor, dew-point, and leaf/product-temperature controls
sources.useAndLimitation: Measurement pairing and local surface risk.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Supports drying-air, loading, psychrometric, and process-uniformity concepts; facility airflow mapping and load geometry require occupied-system verification.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Supports gravimetric drying, moisture-loss curves, drying kinetics, and endpoint concepts; weighing method, scale resolution, sampling location, and batch heterogeneity must be controlled locally.

sources.title: The influence of drying and storage on cannabis volatilome and cannabinoids (2024)
sources.useAndLimitation: Three-variety comparative drying and storage study.

sources.title: In Pursuit of Optimal Quality: Cultivar-Specific Drying Approaches (2024)
sources.useAndLimitation: Chemovar-specific controlled-atmosphere drying.

sources.title: Oswald et al. (2021). Identification of a New Family of Prenylated Volatile Sulfur Compounds in Cannabis.
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific volatile sulfur compound study including changes through flowering, curing, and storage; aroma chemistry is chemovar- and method-dependent.

sources.title: Metabolic Profiling of Cannabis Secondary Metabolites for Storage Conditions (2020)
sources.useAndLimitation: One-year whole/ground, temperature, cannabinoid, and terpene stability.

sources.title: The biosynthesis of the cannabinoids (2021 review)
sources.useAndLimitation: Mechanistic review covering cannabinoid-acid decarboxylation and degradation with heat, oxygen, light, and time; quantitative kinetics depend on matrix and process conditions.

sources.title: Postharvest drying/curing study in industrial hemp (2025)
sources.useAndLimitation: Curing, moisture absorption, microbes, and knowledge gaps.

sources.title: Volume 16 postharvest microbial and mycotoxin source register
sources.useAndLimitation: Organism, viable count, toxin, and remediation distinctions.

sources.title: ASTM D8196-22 and D8197-22 — Cannabis flower water-activity practice and storage specification
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific water-activity quality-control standards; these do not replace jurisdiction-specific microbial testing panels, action limits, sampling rules, or laboratory accreditation requirements.

sources.title: CDC/NIOSH — Cannabis Industry Workplace Safety and Health Hazards
sources.useAndLimitation: Authoritative cannabis-worker hazard guidance covering biological exposures, microbials, organic particulate matter, and controls; worker-protection evidence does not determine product release status.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review (2022)
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis packaging and storage review covering moisture transfer, material permeability, temperature, and quality changes; package qualification still requires product- and material-specific barrier data.

sources.title: U.S. CPSC — Poison Prevention Packaging Act and 16 CFR Part 1700
sources.useAndLimitation: Authoritative U.S. federal framework for child-resistant/senior-friendly special packaging where the PPPA applies; cannabis packaging and labeling requirements remain jurisdiction- and product-specific and require release-time review.

sources.title: Metabolic Profiling of Cannabis Secondary Metabolites for Evaluation of Optimal Postharvest Storage Conditions (2020)
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific one-year storage study examining whole versus ground inflorescence, temperature, cannabinoids, and terpenoids; results are chemovar-, matrix-, container-, and condition-specific.

sources.title: Improved Long-Term Preservation of Cannabis Inflorescence (2024)
sources.useAndLimitation: Treatment-specific storage findings; not a universal prescription.

sources.title: NIST Policy on Metrological Traceability
sources.useAndLimitation: Traceability plus fitness-for-purpose and uncertainty.

sources.title: ASTM D8196-22 — Standard Practice for Determination of Water Activity (aw) in Cannabis Flower
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific measurement practice; instrument-specific calibration/check-standard procedures must follow the current manufacturer method and controlled laboratory procedure.

sources.title: Correlations among morphological and biochemical traits in high-CBD hemp (2023)
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis/hemp evidence for intra-plant and inter-cultivar cannabinoid and biomass variation; supports representative-sampling caution, not a universal sampling design.

sources.title: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Hemp Sampling and Laboratory Testing Guidelines
sources.useAndLimitation: Official U.S. hemp compliance sampling/testing framework for total delta-9 THC on defined lots; it does not substitute for state-specific adult-use/medical cannabis sampling, microbial, pesticide, metals, or proficiency requirements.

sources.title: U.S. FDA — Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Quality System Inspection Technique
sources.useAndLimitation: General quality-system framework for investigating problems, identifying causes, implementing corrective/preventive action, verifying effectiveness, and documenting results; used as a transferable quality method, not as cannabis-specific regulation.

sources.title: Current product remediation, rework, disposal, and release rules
sources.useAndLimitation: Review each release.

reviewNote: External-source resolution pass completed for major postharvest science, water-activity, packaging, sampling, worker-safety, and CAPA references. Jurisdiction-specific cannabis inventory, microbial, remediation, waste, and release rules remain explicit release-time controls rather than falsely generalized national rules.
